Questions.question: Why does the recorded message advise listeners to decide the purpose of the TIN first?
Questions.answer: Because a TIN is required before continuing with other business registrations.
options: Because a PIN is required to obtain the business registration form.
Because a TIN is required before continuing with other business registrations.
Because a number of documents are needed before continuing with the registration.

Questions.question: What is the correct action before filling in the application form?
Questions.answer: Making sure all necessary personal information is ready.
options: Making sure all the necessary copies of documents are attached to the form.
Making sure all necessary personal information is ready.
Making sure the necessary information is attached.

Questions.question: At which stage should the required documents be attached?
Questions.answer: After completing the form but before submitting it.
options: After downloading the form but before submitting it.
After completing the form but before submitting it.
After completing the form and submitting it.

Questions.question: What may happen during the submission of the application form?
Questions.answer: An officer may ask questions to verify identity details.
options: An officer may ask questions to verify the registration details.
An officer may ask for additional business verification details.
An officer may ask questions to verify identity details.

Questions.question: What does the word “eventually” refer to in the process?
Questions.answer: The approval of the application after the review process.
options: The approval of the review process after the application.
The approval of the application after the review process.
The approval of the application before the review process.

activity_c.text: First, decide why you need to apply for a TIN.
Many people need to apply for a TIN to open a business account or to register a new business.
If you are starting your own business, a TIN is required before you can continue with other registrations.
Second, you must apply for a TIN using the official application form.
Before you begin filling in the form, make sure you have all the necessary information ready.
Next, complete the application form carefully.
These usually include a copy of your NIC and proof of address.
Attach required documents before submitting the form, and ensure that all copies are clear and readable.
After you have completed the form, submit the application form to the Inland Revenue Department.
During submission, an officer may ask questions to verify identity details.
Eventually, after the review process is completed, the department will approve your application.
You will receive the TIN number once approval is granted.
Finally, keep your TIN number safely.
